e.busyRootCause.originalSymptom: tests/production-connector-policy.test.js subtest 2 failed with EBUSY unlink state.db-shm at teardown
e.busyRootCause.rootCause: Test asserted PRODUCTION_CAPABILITY_DENIED for a create with maxSourceBytes=257MiB, but the reviewed pinned policy ceiling is 10 GiB (PRODUCTION_POLICY.maxSourceBytes). The create legitimately succeeded; the assertion threw while the created-but-never-closed service leaked its open RunStore SQLite handle; the finally-block rm then failed EBUSY and REPLACED the original assertion error, masking the real cause every run.
e.busyRootCause.probeEvidence: Bare-node replication of the exact subtest body (50+ denial probes) closed and removed cleanly; isolated creates with 257MiB succeeded with no leak; RunStore.close() verified correct (wal_checkpoint TRUNCATE + db.close).
e.busyRootCause.fix: Test aligned to reviewed bound (deny PRODUCTION_POLICY.maxSourceBytes+1, close the legal 257MiB create); teardown hardened with fs.rm maxRetries:5/retryDelay:100 for transient Windows AV locks — genuine leaks still fail after retries.

qualificationEvidenceRootCause.originalSymptom: scripts/qualify-sqlite-production.js failed with ENOENT reading resource-summary.json at the finally block, with an empty measurement.log
qualificationEvidenceRootCause.rootCause: Two defects plus a real environment limit. (1) The parent parsed the summary directly, so any earlier failure was replaced by ENOENT. (2) measure-local-process.py wrote its summary only inside the sampling loop, so a never-sampled run produced no file at all. (3) The actual masked failure was the mandatory 10 GiB free-space preflight on C: (1.33 GiB free).
qualificationEvidenceRootCause.fix: src/platform/measurement-evidence.js readResourceSummary returns a failure value instead of throwing; the monitor writes a summary before and after the loop; qualification reruns on E: (424 GiB free) with TEMP/TMP redirected.
qualificationEvidenceRootCause.result: tests/measurement-evidence.test.js 5/5; qualifier now reports the real cause
